name: LastPass API Patterns
description: The LastPass Business and MSP admin tool surface as exposed through Conduit: the 23 read-only tools and their Conduit tier, Business key versus MSP key scope, the `X-LastPass-API-Key` header, `max_results` / `page_token` pagination, wildcard and `[from:to]` range filters, the users LastPass silently omits from lists, the user record fields, and the error vocabulary (401 early access, 403 wrong key type, 429 shared limits, oversize pages).
